title: Modul POS - Order Management - Panduan Lengkap
description: Panduan lengkap mengelola order di POS mencakup Mode A (Goods/Retail) dan Mode B (F&B) dari pembuatan order hingga completion dengan berbagai workflow.
author: Tim GIMS

content.body: Order Management adalah core dari POS untuk mencatat transaksi penjualan. POS support dua mode operasi: Mode A (Goods/Retail) untuk penjualan cepat di toko, dan Mode B (F&B/Restaurant) untuk restoran dengan kitchen coordination. Setiap order punya lifecycle dari draft sampai completion dengan berbagai status transitions.

items.title: Mode A - Goods/Retail (Penjualan Barang)
items.body:
Mode ini untuk penjualan retail barang dagangan biasa, cocok untuk toko, supermarket, minimarket.

**Order Status Flow:**
```
DRAFT → CONFIRMED → PAID → COMPLETED
                 ↘ VOIDED (cancel with reversal)
```

**Status Details:**

1. **DRAFT**: Order dalam keranjang belanja
   - Items dapat ditambah/dikurangi
   - No stok impact
   - No payment collected
   - Duration: Usually minutes
   - Action: Add/remove items, confirm, apply discount

2. **CONFIRMED**: Order siap dibayar
   - Stok sudah validated (cukup atau tidak)
   - Items tidak boleh diubah
   - Waiting for payment
   - Duration: Seconds sampai menit
   - Action: Process payment

3. **PAID**: Pembayaran sudah diterima
   - Stok deduction executed
   - Receipt generated
   - Payment recorded
   - Duration: Very short
   - Action: Print receipt, complete order

4. **COMPLETED**: Order selesai
   - Final state
   - Receipt printed
   - Stok updated
   - Available untuk return (if within window)
   - Action: Can view history, cannot modify

5. **VOIDED**: Order dibatalkan
   - Dapat void dari DRAFT/CONFIRMED/PAID
   - Stok reversal jika sudah deducted
   - Requires manager approval (if > threshold)
   - Final state
   - Action: Can view detail, cannot undo

items.title: Mode B - F&B/Restaurant (Makanan & Minuman)
items.body:
Mode ini untuk restoran/kafe dengan kitchen coordination dan table management.

**Order Status Flow:**
```
DRAFT → SENT_TO_KITCHEN → IN_PROGRESS → READY → SERVED → PAID → COMPLETED
                                                        ↘ VOIDED (with approval)
```

**Status Details:**

1. **DRAFT**: Order dalam pemesanan di meja
   - Staff mencatat menu yang dipesan customer
   - Items dapat ditambah/dikurangi
   - No kitchen notification
   - Duration: Few minutes while ordering
   - Action: Add items, send to kitchen

2. **SENT_TO_KITCHEN**: Order dikirim ke kitchen display
   - Order tampil di KDS (Kitchen Display System)
   - Kitchen mulai persiapan
   - Status transmitted ke kitchen devices
   - Duration: Few seconds
   - Action: Wait for kitchen preparation

3. **IN_PROGRESS**: Kitchen sedang memasak
   - Kitchen staff mark item sedang dikerjakan
   - KDS show progress
   - Front-of-house notified
   - Duration: Minutes (depends recipe)
   - Action: Wait for ready notification

4. **READY**: Makanan siap disajikan
   - Kitchen mark items ready di KDS
   - Audio/visual alert to FoH
   - FoH staff ambil dari kitchen pass
   - Duration: Minutes at pass window
   - Action: Deliver to table

5. **SERVED**: Makanan sudah di-deliver ke meja
   - FoH staff antar ke meja
   - Customer mulai makan
   - Duration: Customer eating time (30min - 1hour)
   - Action: Wait for customer finish, settle payment

6. **PAID**: Pembayaran sudah diterima
   - Customer finish makan, minta bill
   - Payment processed
   - Stok deduction executed
   - Receipt generated
   - Duration: Payment processing time
   - Action: Release table

7. **COMPLETED**: Order & meja selesai
   - Meja di-release (available untuk customer baru)
   - Stok updated
   - Transaction closed
   - Final state
   - Action: Next customer dapat meja

8. **VOIDED**: Order dibatalkan (anytime)
   - Dapat void dari status apapun kecuali COMPLETED (use return)
   - Manager approval required
   - Stok reversal jika sudah deducted
   - Payment reversal jika sudah paid
   - Final state
   - Action: Can view detail

items.title: Step 1: Mulai Order Baru
items.body:
1. Pastikan session sudah OPEN (lihat Session Management)
2. Klik tombol 'New Order' di main POS screen
3. Interface muncul dengan 3 area:
   - LEFT: Product categories & search
   - CENTER: Product list
   - RIGHT: Shopping cart
4. Order baru dengan status DRAFT tercipta di background
5. Order number auto-generated (e.g., ORD-202605051001)

items.title: Step 2: Tambah Item ke Keranjang
items.body:
1. **Find Product:**
   - Browse by category (Makanan, Minuman, Snack, dll)
   - Atau search by name/barcode
   - Click product untuk select

2. **Input Quantity:**
   - Dialog muncul: "Quantity?"
   - Default: 1
   - Input desired quantity
   - Click 'Add' button

3. **Item Muncul di Cart:**
   - Display: [Product name] × [qty] = Rp [subtotal]
   - Can see unit price, qty, line total
   - Click item untuk modify qty
   - Click X button untuk remove

4. **Repeat untuk Items Lain:**
   - Add multiple items
   - Cart accumulate
   - Real-time cart total update

**Example:**
- Add Bakso × 2 = Rp 50.000
- Add Es Teh × 3 = Rp 15.000
- Add Gorengan × 1 = Rp 5.000
- Cart Total: Rp 70.000

items.title: Step 3: Review & Modifikasi Item
items.body:
1. **Check Cart:**
   - Ensure semua item benar
   - Qty sesuai dengan order
   - Harga reasonable

2. **Modify Item (if needed):**
   - Click item di cart
   - Change qty (input new amount, click update)
   - Add special notes (e.g., "no garlic", "extra spicy")
   - Click save

3. **Remove Item (if needed):**
   - Click X / trash icon
   - Confirm remove
   - Item removed dari cart
   - Total recalculated

4. **Stock Alert:**
   - If item stok habis → warning shown
   - Can remove item atau use substitute
   - Or wait for restock (if same day delivery available)

items.title: Step 4: Confirm Order (Stock Validation)
items.body:
1. **Click 'Confirm Order' button**
   - System move to next stage: CONFIRMED
   - Trigger stock validation

2. **Stock Validation:**
   - System check: apakah stok cukup untuk semua item?
   - For STOCK mode: Check available qty >= order qty
   - For RECIPE mode: Check all ingredients available
   - Results:
     * OK: "Stock sufficient, proceeding"
     * INSUFFICIENT: "Stock not enough for item X, please reduce qty or remove"

3. **Handling Insufficient Stock:**
   - Option A: Reduce qty untuk item tertentu
     * Adjust quantity di cart
     * Reconfirm
   - Option B: Remove item
     * Delete dari cart
     * Reconfirm
   - Option C: Cancel order
     * Discard order
     * Start new order

4. **Order Status → CONFIRMED:**
   - Once stock validation pass
   - Status change to CONFIRMED
   - Items locked (cannot modify)
   - Ready untuk payment

items.title: Step 5: Apply Discount (Optional)
items.body:
1. **Click 'Discount' button** (if order total > 0)
   - Dialog muncul: "Apply Discount?"

2. **Select Discount Type:**
   - Percentage (%): e.g., 10%, 20%, 50%
   - Fixed Amount (Rp): e.g., Rp 5.000, Rp 10.000
   - Voucher code: Enter promo code

3. **Input Discount Value:**
   - For %: Input percentage
   - For Rp: Input amount
   - For voucher: Scan/enter code, system validate
   - Preview: "Total akan jadi Rp XXX"

4. **Manager Approval (if > threshold):**
   - If discount > Rp 50.000 (threshold configurable)
   - Require manager PIN/approval
   - Manager notification sent
   - Manager approve/reject
   - If approve: Discount applied, continue
   - If reject: Discount cancelled, ask for different amount

5. **Confirm Discount:**
   - Click 'Apply' button
   - Discount calculated & deducted from total
   - Cart total updated
   - Show: Original price, discount amount, new total

**Example:**
- Subtotal: Rp 70.000
- Discount 10%: -Rp 7.000
- New total: Rp 63.000

items.title: Step 6: Payment Processing
items.body:
1. **Order ready untuk payment**
   - Status: CONFIRMED
   - Items & discount finalized
   - Total amount: Rp 63.000 (in example)

2. **Select Payment Method:**
   - Click 'Pay' atau 'Checkout' button
   - Payment method dialog muncul:
     * Cash (Tunai)
     * Debit/Credit Card
     * QRIS
     * Multi-payment (2+ methods)
     * Other (Cek, Voucher, etc)

3. **Process Payment:**
   - See Payment Processing section untuk detail
   - Collect payment from customer
   - Verify & confirm
   - Payment executed

4. **Order Status → PAID:**
   - Once payment confirmed
   - Status change to PAID
   - Stock deduction executed
   - Receipt auto-generated

5. **Receipt & Completion:**
   - Receipt displayed
   - Print receipt (auto atau manual)
   - Order status → COMPLETED
   - Transaction finished
   - Next order: Click 'New Order' again

items.title: Step 1: Assign Table to Customer
items.body:
1. **Enter F&B Mode:**
   - From menu, select 'F&B Operations'
   - Screen show floor plan dengan meja-meja
   - Meja status: Available (kosong), Occupied (terisi), Reserved, Pending Payment

2. **Customer Datang:**
   - Greet customer
   - Assess group size: Berapa orang?

3. **Assign Meja:**
   - Click meja kosong (status Available)
   - Dialog muncul:
     * Table selection confirmed
     * Input number of guests (pax)
     * Select server (optional)
   - Click 'Confirm Assignment'
   - Meja status → Occupied
   - Meja di-reserve untuk grup ini

items.title: Step 2: Buat Order di Meja
items.body:
1. **Staff approach meja dengan device/tablet**
   - Click meja yang Occupied
   - Order form terbuka
   - Order created dgn status DRAFT
   - Order linked ke table_id

2. **Tambah Menu Item:**
   - Staff browse menu (kategori: appetizer, main, dessert, drink)
   - Click product untuk select
   - Quantity dialog muncul
   - Input qty + special request
     * Example: "medium done", "no garlic", "extra sauce"
   - Click 'Add to Order'

3. **Multiple Items:**
   - Repeat untuk items lain
   - Accumulate di order cart
   - Real-time total update

4. **Customization:**
   - Staff bisa add note per item
   - Untuk kitchen coordination
   - Example: "Steak - medium done, no butter"

items.title: Step 3: Send Order ke Kitchen
items.body:
1. **Order dalam status DRAFT:**
   - Staff selesai catat semua item
   - Click tombol 'Send to Kitchen'
   - Dialog konfirmasi muncul
   - Review semua item sebelum send

2. **Send Confirmation:**
   - Click 'Confirm Send'
   - System execute:
     * Order status → SENT_TO_KITCHEN
     * Timestamp recorded
     * Order transmitted ke KDS (Kitchen Display System)

3. **Kitchen Notification:**
   - Order muncul di KDS screens
   - Kitchen staff see:
     * Table number & pax count
     * Item list dgn qty & special request
     * Timestamp (when order sent)
   - Kitchen mulai persiapan

4. **Front-of-House Notification:**
   - FoH device show: "Order sent to kitchen"
   - Server dapat assist customer sambil tunggu

items.title: Step 4: Track Kitchen Progress
items.body:
1. **During Preparation:**
   - FoH staff dapat view order status
   - Kitchen mark items: "Cooking", "Ready", "Done"
   - KDS show progress
   - Estimated time untuk completion

2. **Order Progress Display:**
   - Status: IN_PROGRESS
   - Item status individual:
     * Nasi Goreng: IN_PROGRESS (8 min)
     * Es Teh: READY (ready pick up)
     * Gorengan: READY (ready pick up)
   - Color coding:
     * Blue: Fresh order
     * Yellow: Being prepared
     * Green: Ready for pickup
     * Red: Overdue (preparing too long)

3. **Notification to FoH:**
   - When items READY: Audio/visual alert
   - Server notified untuk pickup
   - "Order #3 ready for pickup"

4. **Multiple Kitchen Stations:**
   - Order can be split across stations
   - Grill station: Steak, grilled fish
   - Fryer station: Fried items
   - Beverage station: Drinks
   - Expediter: Plating & final check
   - Order READY only when ALL stations complete

items.title: Step 5: Serve & Deliver Makanan
items.body:
1. **Items Ready di Kitchen Pass:**
   - All items finished
   - Plating done
   - Quality check pass
   - Ready untuk delivery

2. **FoH Pickup:**
   - Server ambil plate dari kitchen pass
   - Verify item sesuai order
   - Check temperature, presentation
   - If issue: Return ke kitchen untuk rework

3. **Deliver ke Meja:**
   - Server antar ke table
   - Serve dengan good service
   - Customer confirm semua item ada

4. **Mark Served:**
   - FoH staff click 'Served' di order
   - System update: Order status → SERVED
   - Timestamp recorded
   - Meja status: Still OCCUPIED
   - Customer dapat makan

5. **Multi-Course Order:**
   - Jika order punya multiple courses
   - Kitchen prepare sequentially
   - Serve one course at time
   - Mark served per course (bisa batch)
   - Order tidak langsung COMPLETED (wait settle payment)

items.title: Step 6: Payment & Settle
items.body:
1. **Customer Finish Makan:**
   - Staff observe: Customer selesai/tidak?
   - When finish: "Can I get the check, please?"

2. **Prepare Bill:**
   - Click order → 'Settle Payment' / 'Close Table'
   - Bill display:
     * Order items & price
     * Subtotal
     * Discount (if any)
     * Tax (if applicable)
     * Total amount

3. **Process Payment:**
   - See Payment Processing section
   - Collect payment from customer
   - Process via payment method
   - Verify & confirm

4. **Order Status → PAID:**
   - Once payment confirmed
   - Status change to PAID
   - Stock deduction executed
   - Receipt generated

5. **Release Table:**
   - Click 'Release Table' / 'Close Table'
   - Order status → COMPLETED
   - Table status → Available (ready untuk customer baru)
   - Clean table (mark DIRTY → CLEAN)
   - Transaction finished

items.title: Mengubah Order Sebelum Confirm
items.body:
While order dalam status DRAFT (sebelum confirm):

1. **Change Quantity:**
   - Click item di cart
   - Change qty (increase/decrease)
   - Save
   - Cart total recalculated

2. **Remove Item:**
   - Click X / trash icon
   - Confirm remove
   - Item removed

3. **Add Item:**
   - Add more products
   - No limit saat DRAFT

4. **Add Special Notes:**
   - Click item → Add notes
   - Untuk kitchen (F&B) atau special request
   - Example: "no garlic", "extra spicy", "nut allergy"

After CONFIRMED: Items locked, cannot modify without void & rebuat order

items.title: Add Item Setelah Order Confirmed (F&B Mode)
items.body:
In F&B Mode, customer bisa add item saat order sedang di-prepare di kitchen.

Proses:
1. Customer: "Add one more Es Teh"
2. Staff: Open order → Click 'Add Item'
3. Add item ke existing order
4. Choose: Send immediately or batch with existing order
5. If send immediately: New item go separate ke kitchen
6. Kitchen prepare, add to same table order
7. Serve saat ready
8. Payment: Include all items at settlement

Note: Modify hanya bisa DRAFT. Untuk add item after CONFIRMED di F&B:
- Create separate order line item (linked to same table)
- Or void & recreate (complex)
- Best practice: Ask customer to order saat masih DRAFT

content.body:
1. **Order Creation:**
   - Require active OPEN session
   - Auto-generate unique order number
   - Start with DRAFT status
   - Link to operator, session, outlet

2. **DRAFT Status:**
   - Items unlimited dapat ditambah/dikurang
   - No stock impact
   - Can stay DRAFT indefinitely (not practical)
   - Can discard DRAFT order

3. **CONFIRMED Status:**
   - Stock validated (must be sufficient)
   - Items locked (cannot modify)
   - Transition to PAID after payment
   - Transition to VOIDED if cancelled

4. **PAID Status:**
   - Stock deduction executed
   - Payment recorded
   - Receipt generated
   - Transition to COMPLETED

5. **COMPLETED Status:**
   - Final state (immutable)
   - Cannot modify items/payment
   - Available untuk return (if within window)
   - Kept untuk history & reporting

6. **VOIDED Status:**
   - Requires manager approval (if > threshold)
   - Stock reversal executed
   - Payment reversal (if already paid)
   - Final state
   - Cannot undo

7. **F&B Specific (Mode B):**
   - Order linked to table
   - Table status transition with order
   - Multiple orders can be pending per table (for add items)
   - Settlement consolidate all orders per table
